title: Spider-Man, BTS and Stranger Things win big at the Kids' Choice Awards
summary: Tom Holland and Zendaya were named favourite movie actor and actress as the show aired on CBS for the first time.
body:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day was named Favorite Movie at Nickelodeon's Kids' Choice Awards on Saturday 14 November, and its stars Tom Holland and Zendaya won Favorite Movie Actor and Favorite Movie Actress.

The ceremony was shown on CBS as well as Nickelodeon for the first time.

Other winners

  • BTS won three awards, including Favorite Song for "Swim" and Favorite Album for Arirang.
  • Bruno Mars and Rosé won Favorite Male Artist and Favorite Female Artist.
  • Katseye were named Favorite Breakout Artist.
  • Stranger Things won Favorite Family TV Show, and Percy Jackson and the Olympians won Favorite Kids TV Show.
  • Jenna Ortega and Joe Keery won TV acting awards, and Lionel Messi was named Favorite Male Sports Star.

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter, Billboard, The Philippine Star.
